q: To cheer Steve up after the flight fiasco, Ricky offered him something 'better than 80 quid'. What was it?

ex: I’ll tell you what’ll cheer you up. I’ll tell you what’s better than 80 quid. I’ll tell you what’s better than that, shall I?
What you paying the whole hundred and sixty five?
Listen, no I’ve brought in a little track here um, Bruce Springsteen off the Tunnel of Love album and uh, I know you’re a Springsteen fan.

q: Mocking Steve's bachelor hopes, what did Ricky claim Heat magazine had once ranked him?

I was... Yeah, according to Heat, I was 22nd most sexy man in the world.
I'd better take that helmet back.

ex: Don't steal our sun - The Thrills on Xfm 104.9. I'm Ricky Gervais with me Steve Merchant, over there Karl Pilkington, The man who believes anything. I think it might be a condition due to his little round head. It might be a new condition…

ex: How many are these mice did they experiment on?

I didn't read the intricacies of the.
Did they have tails? Did they still have their tail?

q: Karl said he'd be a good dad but wouldn't be the one shouting at the kid. Who did Ricky suggest to do the shouting?

ex: And I'd play with it, I think I'd be a good dad.
But I wouldn't be the one shouting at it.
No, who would you get to shout at it probably Windsor Davis, he'd be good wouldn't he. "You horrible little man".
You know I'd tell it the rights and wrong, you don't have to be a really bright person to know rights and wrong in the world.

q: Imagining Karl as a dad, Ricky played his kid asking "Dad how much can an ant lift?" What was "Karl's" answer?

ex: “Dad how much can an ant lift?”
“’bout a, ‘bout a quarter of a kilogram. Probably.”
If you guess, it’s not fact.

a: What's the sound of one leg hopping?

What's the sound of one monkey clapping?
What's the sound of one head nodding?

ex: If you know the answer about that metaphysical question or, indeed, any of the famous ones; uh, if a tree falls in a forest and no one hears it, has it fallen over?
If you leave the room, Rick, does it get quieter?
Yeah. What’s- yeah. What’s the sound of one leg hopping?

q: Steve said the first series of Big Brother felt like a genuine social experiment. What did Ricky say it's like now?
a: Putting ants in a jar and shaking it

A zoo where the keepers have gone on strike

There was intrigue, there was drama. It was genuinely great, hypnotic television.
Now it's like putting ants in a jar and shaking it.
Yeah. I don't know-- but even that, I couldn't watch that once a night every week.

So I'll call myself 'Clint Iron'. What would you call yourself? I mean, Karl Pilkington, nothing wrong with that. It's quite a superhero's name. "It's Pilkington!"

Yeah. I don't think our fans hoover.
I think you've got to have a house. To hoover. I tell you what I do want though: Some great music.

It's the worst when they recognize me. That's why I've got about eight standing orders now where I've been caught.

The name of Postman Pat's cat

Because they'll be stitched up by a question of "Who's in Hollyoaks?" It will be--, yeah.
It'll be... "What characters Andy Lincoln played in This Life?" and they won't get it and you'll go: "Egg". And you'll be correct!

So I do it to annoy -

It's sort of like life's a bit of a chore for Karl, innit?

The drummer's mum, who paid for the van
